description: Nivelles - Parking spaces for disabled people is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by City of Nivelles. Localisation des emplacements de stationnement réservés aux détenteurs d'une carte de stationnement pour personnes en situation de handicap. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are parking, disabled, Nivelles, disability, pmr. The portal shows 99 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
